essence: Past sway, gnosis, dispassion, writs: no loftier haven cut off from you.
Unwished none crooks straw; wished all shoulder Brahmā's load.
Gem-crested wise bow to no Highest but Hara's.
Quiverless sweet mere mid knowing-sea dwelt in.
Askance-seen, fancy-strayed, last fruit granted whole.
None stronger virtned or stringless: bless or curse unsayable.
None fit to sip nectar-fruit, much less serve it, but you.
One begging from all-desire hoard: love of you solely.
Unbarred triple-kingship might hailed with its court.

sections.SUMMARY: Bunter of Yama, bruiser of Smara, river-crowned, righter. Prayer's perch towers past rule, ken, calm, canon; sundered from you, no shelter stands higher. Unbid, none buckles sedge; bid, all haul heaven's draught. Jewel-pated sages kneel to none Highest save Hara's. Still mere of honey mid mind's main sued for lodgement. Sidelong seen or dream-roamed, ripest meed dealt entire. Brawn or bareness none outranks; hail or hale unspeakable. Nectar yield none else may taste, let alone ladle. From the all-wish barn one alms craved: thee-love lonely. Unchecked triple-throne force cheered amid courtiers.

rasa.justification: Ender, crusher, hauler, dealer, crowner: powers pleaded to share power.
